steps.content: Sibilla is good at running away. She's always been able to claw her way back from the brink of death, but sometimes, survival is no kinder than an early grave. Now, in the heart of the frenzied sandstorm, she staggers forward, delirious. Her body betrays her, collapsing again and again, yet still she forces herself up, driven by something beyond thought.
Under a sky stained Mania-red, the sand screams on the wind as twilight bleeds into the dunes. Monsters lurk within the storm, occasionally rasping like crows circling rotten meat.
Yet in her dying hallucinations, the only destination she can still remember remains hopelessly far away.
Amidst the raging sandstorm, the traveler catches fleeting glimpses of DisCity's towering skyline, shimmering like a mirage on the distant horizon.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: There's still a chance... still hope... I must get into DisCity. I have to find that person...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: He will listen... He will help us... I must...
steps.female_content: She will listen... She will help us... I must...

steps.content: Like a dying flame's last gasp of light, she musters her final strength, fingers tightening around the protective charm.

steps.speaker: Villager in the Dream
steps.content: ...Here! We made this bracelet together. It's a protective charm for you! I learned from my big sister. Each bead represents one of us, to keep you safe.

steps.speaker: Villager in the Dream
steps.content: May the sandstorms never hurt you. May you always have food and warm clothes. May you never feel lonely and despair, and may you find good friends and companions wherever you go!

Friends...? Companions...? Jasmine... is she still alive? Clarity has long since slipped from Sibilla's grasp. Now, only instinct drives her forward as the same fractured memories loop endlessly in her mind.

steps.speaker: Villager in the Dream
steps.content: Safe travels! We'll be here waiting for you!

The rumbling of sandworms closes in around her as she collapses to the ground at last. Like driftwood caught in a relentless tide, she sinks, the currents of sand swallowing her inch by inch. Her consciousness wanes, and she can no longer tell if the distant city is real or just a mirage.

Then, a massive shadow engulfs the city—and at last, the traveler surrenders, letting the darkness swallow her in despair. In her final moment of consciousness, a vision flickers: a merchant ship grotesquely opulent.
